Subject: Re: [ILUG] Switch off console

Michael Watterson wrote: > I assumed something like that. I won't be using ssh. Imagine two > industrial "things" connected by serial cable. Put them at two sites, > each with Mobile Internet Router with serial port (each configured with > the other box's Public IP, which doesn't change, as it's not > GPRS/GSM/EDGE/3G/HSDPA dialup, but an native IP based system that always > assigns the same IP to same modem MAC). So the "things" talk to each other, they do not provide a console. I.E do you want serial port redirection rather than remote serial console. There seem to be a couple of redirectors here (msredird, sredird): http://www.ibiblio.org/pub/Linux/system/serial/ Googling also throws up a couple of commercial solutions. > So basically keep commenting out any reference to tty in any > configuration script in /etc  I wish there was a  consistent  list and  > all distros  did the same.
